description.value:
Beginning of 1st level, as a free action, the astrologian is able to summon a star globe. A star globe is a floating, glowing, core in which a deck of tarot cards floats in an orbit around. It is the central foci for the astrologian's Draw abilities.

Functioning only in the hands of an astrologian, as a standard action, the star globe sends out a blast of energy that deals 1d4 + Wisdom modifier points of non-elemental damage. The astrologian must make a ranged touch attack that has a set range of 25 feet + 5 feet per two astrologian levels after 1st. The star globe disappears if the astrologian is unconscious, dead, or if it leaves the astrologian's hands for any length of time.

A star globe floats over one of the astrologian's hands and only requires that hand to fire. This weapon cannot be upgraded, except for certain astrologian secrets such as Enchanted Globe, but can be selected for weapon feats. The globe cannot be disarmed or sundered.
